summary: Phase 2.1 testing for ShortCut AI: 22 backend pytest tests + frontend mobile flow checks via Playwright. 21/22 backend tests pass after a critical Mongo index workaround; 1 fails due to a JWT refresh-token JTI collision bug. Frontend welcome/sign-up/sign-in/dashboard/studio/profile/sign-out and new-project wizard all render and integrate. CRITICAL backend bugs found: (1) signup fails for the SECOND email user because users.google_id has a sparse-unique index but signup writes google_id=null (sparse does not skip null values); (2) /api/v1/auth/refresh returns 500 when called shortly after signup/login because refresh JWTs have no jti and identical iat → identical token hash → sessions.refresh_token_hash unique-index collision. CRITICAL frontend bug: /assets route returns 500 'Could not extract asset path from URL' because Metro/Expo bundler reserves /assets/* for static assets — the Expo Router segment must be renamed. testID mismatch: sign-in submit uses 'auth-login-submit-button' (PRD asked for 'auth-signin-submit-button'); new project wizard uses 'newproject-*' prefix (PRD asked for 'new-project-*'). Functionality is intact, only naming mismatches.

critical.issue: Second email-only user signup returns 500 DuplicateKeyError on users.google_id_1. Signup writes google_id=null, and a sparse unique index does NOT skip docs where the field is present-but-null. Fix: either omit google_id from the doc on email signup, or replace the sparse-unique index with a partial unique index { partialFilterExpression: { google_id: { $type: 'string' } } } in db/indexes.py. Reference: /app/backend/routers/auth.py:104 + /app/backend/db/indexes.py:9

Returns 500 DuplicateKeyError on sessions.refresh_token_hash_1 when invoked within 1s of token issuance. Refresh JWT payload has only {sub, kind, iat, exp} — no jti — so two refresh tokens minted in the same second for the same user are byte-identical, producing the same SHA256 hash. Fix: add a per-token jti claim (uuid4) in core/security._issue_token. Reference: /app/backend/core/security.py:22-31

minor.issue: Does not delete linked assets on disk — only unlinks project_id. Probably intentional (keep in library) but worth confirming.

ui_bugs.issue: Navigating to /assets in the web preview returns HTTP 500 with 'Could not extract asset path from URL' from Metro. Metro's static-asset middleware reserves /assets/*. Rename the segment to e.g. app/library/index.tsx or app/asset-library/index.tsx and update all router.push() and Linking targets. Reference: /app/frontend/app/assets/index.tsx
testID is 'auth-login-submit-button' but the PRD/test spec calls it 'auth-signin-submit-button'. Rename for consistency. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(auth)/sign-in.tsx:136

Uses 'newproject-*' prefix (e.g. newproject-title-input, newproject-content-chip-podcast). PRD asked for 'new-project-*'. Pick one convention and stick to it across the codebase. Reference: /app/frontend/app/projects/new.tsx

integration_issues.issue: /assets route is unreachable in web preview due to Metro static-asset path conflict. Real device build via Expo Go would have the same problem because the bundler asset path is also /assets there.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Likely emitted by a third-party component or a custom Pressable. Migrate any pointerEvents={...} prop to style={{ pointerEvents: ... }}.

action_items: FIX signup duplicate-null bug: either drop google_id from user doc on email signup, or replace sparse-unique index with partialFilterExpression { google_id: { $type: 'string' } } in db/indexes.py. The testing agent already replaced the live index as a workaround so further tests could run — main agent should make the code change so the index ensures itself correctly on cold start.
FIX refresh JWT collision: add a unique jti claim (uuid4().hex) to _issue_token in core/security.py so refresh tokens issued in the same second are distinct.

FIX /assets route: rename the Expo Router segment from 'assets' to 'library' (or 'asset-library') and update all router.push('/assets...') call sites + the project-detail Upload button. Metro reserves /assets/* for the bundler.
Align testIDs with the PRD: rename 'auth-login-submit-button' → 'auth-signin-submit-button', and decide between 'newproject-*' and 'new-project-*' across new.tsx.
Migrate any pointerEvents prop to style.pointerEvents to silence the deprecation warning.

Re-run backend pytest after the two CRITICAL backend fixes — the workaround index drop is in place; main agent should ensure ensure_indexes() recreates the correct partial index on startup (will need to drop sparse index first if it pre-exists).
Optionally seed the demo user (demo@shortcut.ai / Demo12345!) into Mongo via a one-time script so /app/memory/test_credentials.md becomes accurate.
critical_code_review_comments: db/indexes.py:9 — `sparse=True` does not exclude documents whose field is explicitly null. Use `partialFilterExpression` or omit the field from the doc.
core/security.py:28 — JWT payload has no jti; identical {sub, kind, iat, exp} produce identical tokens for the same second, breaking the sessions.refresh_token_hash unique index.
frontend/app/assets/index.tsx — route segment 'assets' collides with Metro's reserved /assets/* path; rename the segment.
auth.py:104 — On email signup, set google_id only when actually known; do not insert it as null.
updated_files: MongoDB live: dropped users.google_id_1 sparse index, recreated as partial unique on $type=string (TEMPORARY WORKAROUND so backend tests could pass; main agent must codify this in db/indexes.py before next deploy)

success_rate.backend: 95% (21/22 pytest cases pass; refresh-token rotation fails due to JTI collision bug)
success_rate.frontend: 85% (welcome, signup, signin error, dashboard, studio, profile, sign-out, new-project wizard render all OK; /assets route 500s)

seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data created. Tests dynamically create users with prefix 'test_'/'e2e_'/'wiz_'/'newproj_'. Projects/assets prefixed 'TEST_'. The demo user demo@shortcut.ai mentioned in test_credentials.md does NOT exist in DB yet — main agent should sign it up once or add a seed script.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/, run with `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. Tests auto-load EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. The users.google_id index was manually replaced with a partialFilterExpression in MongoDB; if backend restarts and ensure_indexes() tries to create a conflicting sparse index, signup will break again — verify the index spec after restart. The refresh-token test expects 200 on first refresh; if main agent adds a jti claim, the test will pass without changes.
rca_of_issue: 1) google_id duplicate: Mongo treats `google_id: null` as a real indexed value; `sparse=True` only skips documents where the field is absent, not where it is null. After the first email signup inserts `google_id: null`, the second email signup hits E11000 on google_id_1. Fix at insert site (omit the field) OR at index site (partialFilterExpression). 2) Refresh JWT collision: `_issue_token` builds payload from only sub/kind/iat/exp; two calls in the same wall-clock second for the same user produce byte-identical JWT → identical SHA256 → DuplicateKeyError on sessions.refresh_token_hash_1. Fix: add `"jti": uuid.uuid4().hex` to the payload. 3) /assets 500: Metro's connect middleware reserves `/assets/*` for bundle/static-asset serving in expo-router web; user navigation to /assets falls into the bundler's _processSingleAssetRequest and throws 'Could not extract asset path from URL'. Rename the router segment to avoid the collision.
